text: Wildfire Insurance 		Dean Cameron, Director		Department of Insurance Director Cameron, how do we keep those costs down? We’ve seen insurance companies in some states dropping or refusing to renew insurance coverage for homes in fire-prone areas. What’s the current situation like in Idaho? What are you proposing the Legislature do to help address this? How would a fire risk pool work? Does the state have other similar risk pools? (Yes) And it’s not just wildfires. It’s hurricanes and flooding. What else are other states doing? What kind of reception have you received from lawmakers on this plan? How about insurance companies? We know the Department of Lands has a fire risk map in its Forest Action Plan. How does the Department of Insurance work with other agencies on things like fire risk assessment? Where to purchase land and build a home is an individual decision. Why should the state take on some of this risk when people are choosing to build in places vulnerable to fire? (Does this artificially lower the cost of living in a high risk area?) Speaking of individual responsibility, how can assistance with “fire wise” improvements help lower insurance rates? 0
